ttl.name: Camshaft Timing Oil Control Valve Assembly (2AZ-FE)

s-1.ptxt: Install Camshaft Timing Oil Control Valve Assembly

s2.ptxt: Install the camshaft timing oil control valve assembly with the bolt.
Connect the camshaft timing oil control valve connector.
Install the vacuum hose clamp with the bolt.
Start the engine and check that there are no oil leaks from the oil filter and oil pan drain plug joints.
Install the cowl top panel outer with the 8 bolts.
Bend the heater air duct splash shield seal No.2 and water guard plate RH as shown in the illustration, and engage each clamp.
Engage the windshield deicer wire harness connector and 3 clamps, and attach them to the cowl top panel outer. (w/ Cold Area Specification)

s-1.ptxt: Install Cowl Body Mounting Reinforcement RH

s2.ptxt: Install the cowl body mounting reinforcement RH to the cowl top panel outer with the 3 bolts.

s-1.ptxt: Install Windshield Wiper Motor & Link Assembly

s2.ptxt: Install the windshield wiper motor & link assembly with the 2 bolts.
Connect the connector.

s-1.ptxt: Install Cowl Top Ventilator Louver RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 5 claws and install the cowl top ventilator louver RH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the pin and install the front side panel protector NO.1 RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Cowl Top Ventilator Louver LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 11 claws and install the cowl top ventilator louver LH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Engage the pin and install the front side panel protector NO.1 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Hood to Cowl Top Seal

s2.ptxt: Engage the 7 clips and install the hood to cowl top seal.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Stop the windshield wiper motor assembly at the automatic stop position.
Using a round file or equivalent, clean the wiper arm serrations. (When reassembling)
Using a wire brush, clean the wiper pivot serrations.
Install the front wiper arm & blade assembly LH with the front wiper arm nut so that it is in the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: While holding the arm hinge by hand, tighten the front wiper arm nut.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Using a round file or equivalent, clean the wiper arm serrations. (When reassembling)
Using a wire brush, clean the wiper pivot serrations.
Install the front wiper arm & blade assembly RH with the front wiper arm nut so that it is in the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: While holding the arm hinge by hand, tighten the front wiper arm nut.

s2.ptxt: Operate the front wipers while spraying water or washer fluid on the glass, and check the wiping condition of the blades and that they do not interfere with the body.

s-1.ptxt: Install Front Wiper Arm Head Cap

s2.ptxt: Install the 2 front wiper arm head caps.
